newsitem.title: USA: Yahoo! shares soar after stock split, Visa deal.
newsitem.headline: Yahoo! shares soar after stock split, Visa deal.

text.p: Shares of Yahoo! Inc surged to a record high Wednesday, jumping 13 percent after the company announced a three-for-two stock split and a deal to buy out Visa's stake in a joint venture.

The stock gained $6.375 to $54.625 in volume of nearly two million shares on the Nasdaq market -- more than four times normal daily activity. At its peak, the Internet search and navigation company's shares reached $55.

Analysts applauded the timing of the stock split, which applies to shareholders of record on August 11, and said the deal to buy out Visa's stake in its electronic commerce operation carried a reasonable price.
"I think this ends up being a net positive for Yahoo!" said Keith Benjamin, an analyst at Robertson Stephens & Co.

"Commerce is becoming big on the Web and here's an indication that in order to take Visa out of their potential share of Yahoo!'s commerce revenues, they think it's worth more than $20 million," Benjamin said.

Yahoo!, based in Santa Clara, California, said late Tuesday it was issuing 466,321 shares of its common stock to the Visa Group credit-card association, and taking a one-time, non-cash pretax charge of $21,245,000 in its second quarter to reflect the value of the shares.

The company and analysts said the dilution of about 1.5 percent was nominal for the company, which has just begun turning a profit this year, and the deal gave Yahoo! full control of its electronic commerce venture.
Visa had held a 45 percent stake in the limited liability joint venture, Yahoo! Marketplace LLC.

Nonetheless, Yahoo! and Visa International will proceed with a global partnership which will include co-branded shopping guides, a co-branded Yahoo! Visa card and joint promotions of the two brands through online and offline media.
Visa, which is comprised of 21,000 member financial institutions, has nearly 600 million cards, accepted at more than 14 million worldwide locations.
